ar.title: ساندويتش هامبورجر الدجاج

steps.n1: يخلط الدجاج المفروم بالبصلة والثوم والبيضة والملح والفلفل والبهار والزيت خلطا جيدا وتترك لمدة ساعتين في الثلاجة.
steps.n3: نضع زيتا في طاسة تيفال ونضع كل وحدة فيها على درجة حرارة هادئة مع تقليبها على الوجه الآخر حتى النضج.
steps.n4: نحضر الكايزر لحشوه بالهامبورجر مع وضع الكاتشب وشرائح الفلفل الأخضر والجبن الشيدر.

en.title: Chicken Burger Sandwich

steps.n1: Mix the minced chicken with the onion, garlic, egg, salt, pepper, spices, and oil thoroughly, then let it rest in the refrigerator for 2 hours.
steps.n2: Shape the mixture into round patties.
steps.n3: Heat oil in a non-stick pan and place each patty in the pan over low heat, flipping until cooked through.
steps.n4: Prepare the buns by filling them with the chicken patties, adding ketchup, green pepper slices, and cheddar cheese.

legacySteps: Mix the minced chicken with the onion, garlic, egg, salt, pepper, spices, and oil thoroughly, then let it rest in the refrigerator for 2 hours.
Shape the mixture into round patties.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan and place each patty in the pan over low heat, flipping until cooked through.
Prepare the buns by filling them with the chicken patties, adding ketchup, green pepper slices, and cheddar cheese.
